source.name: UNEP Global Peatlands Assessment and Global Peatland Hotspot Atlas
source.publisher: United Nations Environment Programme and Global Peatlands Initiative

cadence: Refresh when UNEP publishes a new global peatland assessment or hotspot atlas.
provenance: Reviewed source-reported values from UNEP global assessment, atlas and economics releases. The snapshot keeps damaged share, annual loss, emissions contribution, remediation financing and country extent as separate quantities.
uncertainty: Global peatland mapping and condition inventories remain incomplete. Degraded-area share, annual hotspot loss, emissions attribution, financing requirements and national peatland presence have different assessment years and methods. Required investment is a remediation requirement, not observed economic damage.
failure_behavior: Retain the last reviewed assessment and mark stale; reject changed units or unreconciled geography counts; never infer burned area, affected population, realized monetary damage or a continuous annual history from assessment totals.

assessment.geography_boundary: Global assessments spanning peatlands reported in 177 of 193 United Nations Member States
